dom.scene: A clear natural river swimming cove at midday. She kneels on a smooth dry rock beside shallow water, testing the water with one relaxed hand while the other rests on her thigh; face turned to camera. Sparkling dappled sunshine, fresh summer holiday atmosphere.
dom.outfit: A fully lined navy and pale-blue two-piece swimsuit: secure square-neck top with broad straps, high-leg swim bottoms with full opaque coverage, tiny spiral clasp at the strap. Bare shoulders, midriff and legs, no armor or mechanical parts.
